title: Redesign Leave Application Input Section with 3-Column CSS Grid Layout

requirements.text: Redesign the Input Section of LeaveApplicationPage.tsx to use a CSS grid layout with `display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 16px;` instead of the current full-width stacked layout. Arrange all form fields into exactly 4 rows as follows — Row 1: Recipient Type, Language, Your Name; Row 2: Parent/Guardian Name, School/College Name, Class/Grade; Row 3: Leave Date(s), Leave Duration Type, Reason for Leave; Row 4: Absent Since (Date), Medical Certificate Checkbox, empty third column (use an empty div placeholder or leave the cell unstyled). Do NOT change any form field functionality, values, state, or handlers.

quotes: Use: display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 16px;
Row 1: Recipient Type / Language / Your Name
Row 2: Parent / Guardian Name / School / College Name / Class / Grade
Row 3: Leave Date(s) / Leave Duration Type / Reason for Leave
Row 4: Absent Since (Date) / Medical Certificate Checkbox / (Keep third column empty or adjust spacing properly)

acceptanceCriteria: The input section renders fields in a 3-column grid on screens 768px and wider.
Row 1 contains: Recipient Type, Language, Your Name (left to right).
Row 2 contains: Parent/Guardian Name, School/College Name, Class/Grade (left to right).
Row 3 contains: Leave Date(s), Leave Duration Type, Reason for Leave (left to right).
Row 4 contains: Absent Since (Date) in column 1, Medical Certificate Checkbox in column 2, and an empty/invisible placeholder in column 3.
No field spans more than one grid column unless it was already spanning the full width intentionally.
All form functionality (state, handlers, validation, submission) remains unchanged.

requirements.text: Remove full-width input styling from all fields in the Input Section. Each input, select/dropdown, and checkbox group must respect its grid cell width. Remove any `width: 100%` or equivalent overrides that cause inputs to stretch beyond their grid cell. Ensure all dropdowns and text inputs have a consistent visual width matching their respective grid columns.

quotes: Each input must respect grid column width.
Max width should not exceed its grid cell.
Remove width: 100% from inputs if applied.
Ensure dropdowns and text inputs are same visual width.

acceptanceCriteria: No input or select element in the Input Section has inline or Tailwind `w-full` / `width: 100%` styles that exceed the grid cell boundary.
All text inputs and dropdowns are visually the same width within their respective grid columns.
The layout appears compact and professional with no inputs overflowing their cells.

requirements.text: Add a responsive breakpoint to the Input Section grid: on screens with viewport width below 768px, switch the grid to a single-column layout using `grid-template-columns: 1fr`, stacking all fields vertically.

quotes: On screens below 768px: Switch to: grid-template-columns: 1fr;

acceptanceCriteria: On viewports ≥ 768px, the Input Section renders 3 columns.
On viewports < 768px, the Input Section collapses to a single column with all fields stacked vertically.
The responsive behavior is implemented using a CSS media query or Tailwind responsive prefix (e.g., `sm:grid-cols-3`).

requirements.text: Fix the spacing between the Input Section card and the Output Section. Remove unnecessary `margin-bottom` from the Input card, remove extra padding below the output action buttons, and ensure the output buttons sit close to the bottom edge of the output card. The overall vertical rhythm should be balanced with no excessive white space between the two sections.

quotes: Remove unnecessary margin-bottom from Input card.
Remove extra padding under output buttons.
Ensure output buttons sit near bottom edge.
Maintain balanced spacing (not excessive white space).

acceptanceCriteria: The gap between the Input Section card and the Output Section is visually balanced and not excessive.
The Input card has no large bottom margin or padding that was previously used to account for a taller input layout.
The output action buttons (Copy, Download PDF, etc.) sit near the bottom edge of the output card with minimal extra padding below them.
The page does not show large blank areas between the two sections on desktop or mobile.

constraints: Do NOT change any form field functionality, state management, event handlers, or data flow.
Do NOT modify any files listed in frontend.immutablePaths.
Only restructure the layout and spacing — no feature changes.
nonGoals: Adding new form fields or removing existing ones.
Changing the generated letter output logic or templates.
Modifying the backend or any API calls.
Redesigning the Output Section's visual style beyond spacing fixes.
